kalyani-government-engineering-college.description: Kalyani Government Engineering College is an autonomous Government of West Bengal engineering college on a 75 acre campus in Kalyani, Nadia.
kalyani-government-engineering-college.about: KGEC was established by the Government of West Bengal in 1995. It is an autonomous government institution affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology and approved by AICTE. It holds a NAAC A grade, and its 75 acre campus lies in the planned township of Kalyani.
kalyani-government-engineering-college.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

university-of-kalyani-department-of-comp.description: The Department of Computer Science and Engineering of the University of Kalyani runs an AICTE-approved B.Tech in computer science and engineering on the university campus at Kalyani.
university-of-kalyani-department-of-comp.about: The department was set up in 1992 inside the Department of Physics, starting with a postgraduate diploma in computer applications. It moved into its own building at the end of 2002. The B.Tech in computer science and engineering was introduced in 2022 with AICTE approval.
university-of-kalyani-department-of-comp.address: University of Kalyani, Kalyani, Nadia, West Bengal 741235

university-science-instrumentation-centr.description: The University Science Instrumentation Centre of the University of Kalyani, now the Department of Engineering and Technological Studies, offers B.Tech programmes in electronics and instrumentation and in information technology.
university-science-instrumentation-centr.about: USIC was established at the University of Kalyani in 1978 by the University Grants Commission and was later upgraded to Level III, the only such USIC in the eastern region. After AICTE approval in 1999, it began four-year B.Tech courses in electronics and instrumentation engineering and information technology, admitting students through WBJEE. It also runs an M.Tech in communication engineering and is now known as the Department of Engineering and Technological Studies.
university-science-instrumentation-centr.address: University of Kalyani, Kalyani, Nadia, West Bengal 741235

adamas-university-technical-campus.description: Adamas University is a private university on the Barasat-Barrackpore Road in North 24 Parganas, accredited by NAAC with an A grade.
adamas-university-technical-campus.about: The university was created by the Adamas University Act, 2014 (West Bengal Act IV of 2014) and notified by the state government on 11 April 2014. Its campus is at Barbaria, Jagannathpur, in North 24 Parganas district. It has been awarded an A grade by NAAC.
adamas-university-technical-campus.address: Barasat-Barrackpore Road, Barbaria, PO Jagannathpur, District North 24 Parganas, Kolkata, West Bengal 700126

aliah-university.description: Aliah University is a university in New Town, Kolkata, created by an Act of the West Bengal Legislative Assembly, that offers B.Tech programmes in several engineering disciplines.
aliah-university.about: Aliah University was created by the Aliah University Act (Act XXVII of 2007), which came into force on 5 April 2008. Its main campus is in Action Area IIA of New Town, Kolkata. It offers B.Tech programmes in civil, computer science, electrical, electronics and communication, and mechanical engineering.
aliah-university.address: Action Area IIA/27, New Town, Kolkata, West Bengal 700160

b-p-poddar-institute-of-management-and-t.description: B. P. Poddar Institute of Management and Technology is a private engineering and management college on V.I.P. Road in Kolkata.
b-p-poddar-institute-of-management-and-t.about: BPPIMT was established in 1999 as a tribute to B. P. Poddar, the philanthropist and educationist who founded the group. Its campus is at Poddar Vihar on V.I.P. Road. Several of its programmes carry NBA accreditation.
b-p-poddar-institute-of-management-and-t.address: 137 V.I.P. Road, Poddar Vihar, Kolkata, West Bengal 700052

camellia-school-of-engineering-and-techn.description: Camellia School of Engineering and Technology is a Camellia Group engineering college at Nadibhag near Barasat in North 24 Parganas.
camellia-school-of-engineering-and-techn.about: CSET was established in 2007 by the Camellia Educare Trust. It occupies an 8 acre campus at Kazipara, Barasat. It is affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, and its courses are approved by AICTE.
camellia-school-of-engineering-and-techn.address: Nadibhag, PO Kazipara, Barasat, Kolkata, West Bengal 700124
camellia-school-of-engineering-and-techn.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

elitte-college-of-engiineering.description: Elitte College of Engineering is a private engineering college at Karnamadhabpur near Sodepur in North 24 Parganas, accredited by NAAC with a B+ grade.
elitte-college-of-engiineering.about: The college was established in 2015 by the Pinnacle Educational Trust. It is approved by AICTE and affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal. It received a NAAC B+ grade effective 31 October 2024.
elitte-college-of-engiineering.address: PO Karnamadhabpur, PS Ghola, Sodepur, Kolkata, West Bengal 700113
elitte-college-of-engiineering.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

government-college-of-engineering-and-le.description: Government College of Engineering and Leather Technology is a Government of West Bengal engineering college in Salt Lake, Kolkata, known for its leather technology programme.
government-college-of-engineering-and-le.about: The college was founded on 11 March 1919, just after the First World War. It is under the Directorate of Technical Education, Government of West Bengal, is approved by AICTE and is affiliated to MAKAUT. It has long focused on leather technology and footwear, and added B.Tech courses in information technology in 2000 and computer science and engineering in 2001.
government-college-of-engineering-and-le.address: Block LB 11, Sector III, Salt Lake, Kolkata, West Bengal 700106
government-college-of-engineering-and-le.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal

gurunanak-institute-of-technology.description: Guru Nanak Institute of Technology is an autonomous JIS Group engineering college on Nilgunj Road, Panihati, accredited by NAAC with an A+ grade.
gurunanak-institute-of-technology.about: GNIT was established in 2003 under the JIS Group. It received autonomous status in 2016 and is affiliated to Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology. It holds a NAAC A+ accreditation.
gurunanak-institute-of-technology.address: 157/F Nilgunj Road, Panihati, Kolkata, West Bengal 700114
gurunanak-institute-of-technology.affiliated_to: Maulana Abul Kalam Azad University of Technology, West Bengal
